title: Calculator
description: Adds a calculate command into the game!
body:
# Enzonic-Calculator
```
/calculate
```
 command
### 1. What the plugin does
-     Adds one command: /calculate <expression>
-     Accepts operators: +  –  *  /  %  ^
-     Accepts functions: sqrt  sin  cos  tan  log
-     Constants: pi, e
-     Works from console and in-game.
